27:     companion object Codec : MessageCodec<SourceMessage> {
28:         private const val TX_HEADER: Byte = -1
29:         private const val LEGACY_FLUSH_BLOCK_HEADER: Byte = 2
30:         private const val PROTOBUF_HEADER: Byte = 3
31: 
32:         override fun encode(message: SourceMessage): ByteArray = message.encode()
33: 
34:         override fun decode(bytes: ByteArray): SourceMessage? = parse(bytes)
35: 
36:         @JvmStatic
37:         fun parse(bytes: ByteArray) =
38:             when (bytes[0]) {
39:                 TX_HEADER -> LegacyTx(bytes)
40:                 LEGACY_FLUSH_BLOCK_HEADER -> null
41:                 PROTOBUF_HEADER -> ProtobufMessage.parse(ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).position(1))
42: 
43:                 else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Unknown message type: ${bytes[0]}")
44:             }
45:     }
46:

134:         val msg = record.message
135:         LOG.trace { "[$dbName] leader: message $msgId (${msg::class.simpleName})" }
136: 
137:         return when (msg) {
138:             is SourceMessage.Tx -> appendTx(txResolver.indexTx(msgId, record.logTimestamp, msg))
139: 
140:             is SourceMessage.LegacyTx -> appendTx(txResolver.indexTx(msgId, record.logTimestamp, msg))
141: 
142:             is SourceMessage.FlushBlock -> {
143:                 val expectedBlockIdx = msg.expectedBlockIdx
144:                 val cut = expectedBlockIdx != null && expectedBlockIdx == (tableCatalog.currentBlockIndex ?: -1L)
145: 
146:                 if (cut) blockCutter.cut(msgId, txResolver.resolvedExtToken)
147:                 // see #5680
148:                 else replicaAppender.append(ControlItem(ReplicaMessage.NoOp(srcMsgId = msgId, termId = leaderTerm)))
149: 
150:                 txResolver.advanceSrcMsgId(msgId)
151:                 cut
152:             }
153:

156:                     when (txResolver.stagedDbOp(msg.dbName)) {
157:                         is DbOp.Attach ->
158:                             throw Conflict("Database already exists", "xtdb/db-exists", mapOf("db-name" to msg.dbName))
159: 
160:                         is DbOp.Detach -> throw Conflict(
161:                             "Database is still being detached — retry once the previous detach has completed",
162:                             "xtdb/db-being-detached", mapOf("db-name" to msg.dbName)
163:                         )
164: 
165:                         null -> it.checkCanAttach(msg.dbName, msg.config)
166:                     }
167:                 }
168: 
169:                 appendTx(
170:                     if (error == null)
171:                         txResolver.indexDbOp(msgId, record.logTimestamp, DbOp.Attach(msg.dbName, msg.config))
172:                     else
173:                         txResolver.indexFailedDbOp(msgId, record.logTimestamp, error)
174:                 )
175:             }
176: 
177:             is SourceMessage.DetachDatabase -> {
178:                 val error = checkDbOp(msgId, "detach", msg.dbName) {
179:                     when (txResolver.stagedDbOp(msg.dbName)) {
180:                         // The primary is always held, so it never has one of these; anything that does
181:                         // will be there to detach by the time this op is applied.
182:                         is DbOp.Attach -> {}
183: 
184:                         is DbOp.Detach ->
185:                             throw NotFound("Database does not exist", "xtdb/no-such-db", mapOf("db-name" to msg.dbName))
186: 
187:                         null -> it.checkCanDetach(msg.dbName)
188:                     }
189:                 }
190: 
191:                 appendTx(
192:                     if (error == null)
193:                         txResolver.indexDbOp(msgId, record.logTimestamp, DbOp.Detach(msg.dbName))
194:                     else
195:                         txResolver.indexFailedDbOp(msgId, record.logTimestamp, error)
196:                 )
197:             }
198: 
199:             is SourceMessage.TriesAdded -> {
200:                 // Forwarded whatever its storage version: each node guards the add on the way back in,
201:                 // and this message is also what carries the source watermark forward.
202:                 replicaAppender.append(
203:                     ControlItem(
204:                         TriesAdded(
205:                             msg.storageVersion, msg.storageEpoch, msg.tries,
206:                             sourceMsgId = msgId, termId = leaderTerm
207:                         )
208:                     )
209:                 )
210:                 txResolver.advanceSrcMsgId(msgId)
211:                 false
212:             }
213:         }
214:     }

144:         try {
145:             val res = Array(msgs.size) { idx ->
146:                 val (msg) = msgs[idx]
147:                 // we only use the instantSource for Tx messages so that the tests
148:                 // that check files can be deterministic
149:                 val ts = if (msg is SourceMessage.Tx || msg is SourceMessage.LegacyTx || useInstantSourceForNonTx) instantSource.instant() else Instant.now()
150:                 val payload = codec.encode(msg)
151:                 val size = payload.size
152:                 val offset = logFileChannel.position()
153: 
154:                 logFileChannel.write(
155:                     ByteBuffer
156:                         .allocateDirect(messageSizeBytes(size))
157:                         .run {
158:                             put(RECORD_SEPARATOR)
159:                             putInt(size)
160:                             putLong(ts.asMicros)
161:                             put(payload)
162:                             putLong(offset)
163:                             flip()
164:                         })
165: 
166:                 Record(epoch, offset, ts, msg)
167:             }
168: 
169:             logFileChannel.force(true)
